chrome.about_how_3_unconfirmed.en: Original texts whose terms of use (the KOGL type) are not confirmed are not copied: pages link to them, descriptions are written anew, and values such as hours, fees and menus are kept as the source gives them. Distances are straight lines between coordinates, not travel distances.

chrome.about_photos.en: Photos are from the Korea Tourism Organization under the Korea Open Government License (KOGL): {n1} under {lic1} and {n3} under {lic3}. Type 3 photos are shown exactly as published: never cropped, enlarged or edited. Each photo carries its source and license.

Las fotos de tipo 3 se muestran tal como se publicaron: nunca se recortan, amplían ni editan. Cada foto lleva su fuente y su licencia.

chrome.about_names.en: Place names are the Korea Tourism Organization's official names in this language when it gives one; otherwise they are translated from the Korean name (the proper part transcribed, the generic part translated). Cada página de lugar muestra también el nombre en coreano, útil para buscar en un mapa coreano o enseñárselo a un taxista.
